title: Basedash Subscriptions
summary: Subscribe to any dashboard. Delivered on schedule.
body: Subscribe to any Basedash dashboard or chart and get a fresh snapshot delivered on a schedule—straight to your inbox or a Slack channel. Pick the cadence (every Monday at 9am, daily, monthly on the 1st), choose who receives it, and each delivery arrives with up-to-date charts and a link back to the live dashboard. No exporting, no screenshotting, no remembering to share. The Monday metrics email your team wants, without anyone building it. Your dashboards, delivered on schedule.
